test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Mahatma Gandhi is one of the **__complete__** leaders that the world has ever seen.
solution:
The correct answer is **"out and out."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Complete" **means having or including all parts; with nothing missing. (संपूर्ण; सर्वांशपूर्ण, सारा)

 
 
• **Example**:* I gave a **complete**__ list of the stolen items to the police.*
 
 
 
• **"Out and out"** means completely or thoroughly, which makes sense in the context of the sentence. (संपूर्ण, मुकम्‍मल)
 __
 
• **Example**: *It was **out-and-out**__ war between us.*
 
 
 
• So, the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is **"out and out."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The phrase "often and often" means frequently, but it doesn't fit grammatically in the sentence. (बार-बार)
 
• "Once and again" means occasionally, but it doesn't fit grammatically in the sentence. (कभी-कभी, प्रसंगवश)
 
• "Open and above board" means honest and straightforward, but it doesn't fit semantically in the sentence. (ईमानदार और सीधा)
